name: ActionProvider
description:
Supplies the services every action runs with — navigation, toasts, windows and the
confirm dialog — and mounts the toast viewport and confirm host they need. Mount once at
the app root; pass a navigation adapter when using a different router.

A nested ActionProvider mounts nothing: it inherits the outer services and overrides only
what it is given. A layout that owns a window manager wires `openWindow` this way.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: navigate
props.description: Override navigation with the host router. Defaults to TanStack Router when present, otherwise browser navigation.

props.name: openWindow
props.type: ((kind: string, params: Record<string, string>) => void) | undefined
props.description: Application callback opening a serialisable view in a managed window.
